mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.name, c.address, i.id AS industry_id, i.name AS industry_name, c.registration_number, COALESCE(uc.unit_count, 0) AS unit_count, COALESCE(ec.employee_count, 0) AS employee_count, NULL AS null_col FROM companies c LEFT JOIN industries i ON i.id = c.industry_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT u.company_id, COUNT(*) AS unit_count FROM units u WHERE NOT u.type_id = 1 GROUP BY u.company_id ) uc ON uc.company_id = c.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT u.company_id, COUNT(e.id) AS employee_count FROM units u LEFT JOIN employees e ON e.unit_id = u.id GROUP BY u.company_id ) ec ON ec.company_id = c.id WHERE c.id = #{id}

SELECT c.id, c.name, c.address, i.id AS industry_id, i.name AS industry_name, c.registration_number, COALESCE(uc.unit_count, 0) AS unit_count, COALESCE(ec.employee_count, 0) AS employee_count, NULL AS null_col FROM companies c LEFT JOIN industries i ON i.id = c.industry_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT u.company_id, COUNT(*) AS unit_count FROM units u WHERE NOT u.type_id = 1 GROUP BY u.company_id ) uc ON uc.company_id = c.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT u.company_id, COUNT(e.id) AS employee_count FROM units u LEFT JOIN employees e ON e.unit_id = u.id GROUP BY u.company_id ) ec ON ec.company_id = c.id ORDER BY c.id

SELECT u.id, c.id AS company_id, c.name AS company_name, u.name, t.id AS type_id, t.name AS type_name, u.code, p.id AS parent_id, p.name AS parent_name, COALESCE(ec.employee_count, 0) AS employee_count, NULL AS null_col FROM units u LEFT JOIN companies c ON u.company_id = c.id LEFT JOIN unit_types t ON u.type_id = t.id LEFT JOIN units p ON u.parent_id = p.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT e.unit_id, COUNT(*) AS employee_count FROM employees e GROUP BY e.unit_id ) ec ON ec.unit_id = u.id WHERE u.company_id = #{id} ORDER BY u.id

SELECT u.id, c.id AS company_id, c.name AS company_name, u.name, t.id AS type_id, t.name AS type_name, u.code, p.id AS parent_id, p.name AS parent_name, COALESCE(ec.employee_count, 0) AS employee_count, NULL AS null_col FROM units u LEFT JOIN companies c ON u.company_id = c.id LEFT JOIN unit_types t ON u.type_id = t.id LEFT JOIN units p ON u.parent_id = p.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT e.unit_id, COUNT(*) AS employee_count FROM employees e GROUP BY e.unit_id ) ec ON ec.unit_id = u.id WHERE u.company_id = #{id} AND u.type_id = 1 ORDER BY u.id

SELECT e.id, c.id AS company_id, c.name AS company_name, u.id AS unit_id, u.name AS unit_name, p.id AS position_id, p.name AS position_name, e.first_name, e.last_name, e.email, e.phone, e.dob, NULL AS null_col FROM employees e LEFT JOIN units u ON u.id = e.unit_id LEFT JOIN positions p ON p.id = e.position_id LEFT JOIN companies c ON c.id = u.company_id WHERE u.company_id = #{id} ORDER BY e.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO companies (name, address, industry_id, registration_number) VALUES (#{name}, #{address}, #{industryId}, #{registrationNumber})
mapper.update: UPDATE companies SET name = #{name}, address = #{address}, industry_id = #{industryId}, registration_number = #{registrationNumber} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.name, c.address, i.id AS industry_id, i.name AS industry_name, c.registration_number, COALESCE(uc.unit_count, 0) AS unit_count, COALESCE(ec.employee_count, 0) AS employee_count, NULL AS null_col FROM companies c LEFT JOIN industries i ON i.id = c.industry_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT u.company_id, COUNT(*) AS unit_count FROM units u WHERE NOT u.type_id = 1 GROUP BY u.company_id ) uc ON uc.company_id = c.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT u.company_id, COUNT(e.id) AS employee_count FROM units u LEFT JOIN employees e ON e.unit_id = u.id GROUP BY u.company_id ) ec ON ec.company_id = c.id WHERE LOWER(c.name) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%')) OR LOWER(c.address) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%')) OR LOWER(c.registration_number) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%')) OR LOWER(i.name) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%')) ORDER BY c.id
